{"type":"text","timestamp":1793309512438,"sessionID":"ses_e766dee55ffeGcde6ZX4GJEJtk","part":{"id":"prt_18993924a0017OmDS2eSRYuM87","sessionID":"ses_e766dee55ffeGcde6ZX4GJEJtk","messageID":"msg_189937887001SVGC3cKPxcitcP","type":"text","text":"I wrote `primers.fasta` with one primer pair, which is the minimum because the output differs from the input by a single insertion.\n\nThe output plasmid is the input with a 39-nt insertion, `gtagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaa`. It goes in after position 214, just before `gcaagggcgagg…`. The insertion falls between `…catatg` and `agcaagggc`. A single non-overlapping primer pair, as in the Q5 SDM kit, can make it.\n\nI split the insertion between the two primers as 5' tails. Only the part that anneals to the input counts toward length and Tm.\n\n```\n>fwd\naagaagaagattaacagaaagcaagggcgaggagc\n>rev\naattcttcttctaatctactcatatgtatatctccttcttaaagttaaacaaaatta\n```\n\n| Primer | Annealing part | Length | Tm (`oligotm` with your flags) |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| fwd | `agcaagggcgaggagc` region, 15 nt | 15 nt | 61.69 °C |\n| rev | 38 nt upstream of the insertion site | 38 nt | 61.75 °C |\n\n- **Tm gap:** the two annealing Tms differ by 0.05 °C, well inside the 5 °C limit.\n- **Length and Tm limits:** both annealing parts are between 15 and 45 nt, and both Tms are between 58 and 72 °C.\n- **Product check:** I confirmed that the linear product of this pair (reverse-complemented rev primer plus fwd primer) matches the output plasmid sequence. After KLD circularization it gives the output plasmid.\n\nI did not use the whole-plasmid `oligotm` check on the full primers. Tm was computed only on the annealing portions, as you specified.","time":{"start":1793309512436,"end":1793309512436}}}
